def add_toc_hook(md: 'Markdown', min_level: int=1, max_level: int=3,
    heading_id: Optional[Callable[[Dict[str, Any], int], str]]=None) ->None:
    toc_items = []
    
    def toc_hook(state: BlockState, block: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
        # Process all blocks to find headings
        for i, token in enumerate(block):
            if token.get('type') == 'heading':
                level = token['attrs']['level']
                if min_level <= level <= max_level:
                    # Generate ID if not present
                    if 'id' not in token['attrs']:
                        if heading_id:
                            token['attrs']['id'] = heading_id(token, i)
                        else:
                            # Default ID generation
                            token['attrs']['id'] = token['text'].lower().replace(' ', '-')
                    toc_items.append((level, token['attrs']['id'], token['text']))
        return False  # Don't consume the block
    
    # Add the hook to the markdown parser
    md.block.plugins.append(toc_hook)
    
    # Store toc_items in the markdown instance for later use
    md.toc_items = toc_items
